difficulty_basis.easy: Source-rated single standard primitive; authored complete method banks.
difficulty_basis.moderate: Source-rated two primitive components, or coefficient isolation followed by a scaled trigonometric primitive; authored complete method banks.
difficulty_basis.hard: Explicit authored extension: three familiar primitive components and nonunit derivative coefficient; no initial values, higher derivatives, integrating factors, separation, integration by parts, or inverse-trigonometric rules. Three templates have equal primitive workload.

evidence_only_profiles: All eight original banks remain replayable opaque-bank evidence. They are never sampled as learner inventory. The q-14245 source is unrated and lacks a key and worked solution; its original facts are preserved.
bounds: Nonzero coefficients with absolute value at most 11 and denominator at most 2; rates 1 through 4 in absolute value; reciprocal shifts -3 through 3; fixed polynomial degrees 1 and 2; hard derivative coefficients have absolute value 2 through 5. The documented default sampler is narrower. Whole-bank collisions are rejected.
novelty: The exact normalized forcing function defines the task; seeds, identities, solution layout, bank order, and coefficient rescaling of an equivalent ODE do not create new inventory. Every selected instance is compared symbolically to current source/canonical tasks and selected variants.
